crafts.subtitle: Ford Mustang GT
description: The Mustang GT Performance is the ultimate expression of sportiness within the GT line. It features a 5.0-liter Coyote Gen 4 V8 engine, capable of delivering 486 hp and 567 Nm of torque, improving on both power and efficiency compared to its predecessor. The addition of dual intakes with electronic throttle bodies and an active exhaust system allows for immediate response and a sound that evokes pure performance.

This exhaust was created for those who want to take performance and sound to the next level, maintaining the original aesthetics while unleashing the full character of the V8. Made from high-quality stainless steel, it features a 3-inch diameter and a total length of 78.74 inches, optimizing gas flow and delivering a deeper, sportier tone without the need for structural modifications.

crafts.title: Kawasaki Z 550
crafts.subtitle: Kawasaki Z 550
description: The Kawasaki Z 550 is a legendary motorcycle that has left an indelible mark on the world of motorcycling. With its aggressive design and powerful performance, it has become an icon among motorcycle enthusiasts. The Z 550 features a 553cc inline-four engine that delivers exhilarating power and a thrilling riding experience.

Its distinctive styling, characterized by sharp lines and a muscular stance, sets it apart from the crowd. Whether you're cruising down the highway or carving through twisty roads, the Kawasaki Z 550 offers a perfect blend of performance and style that continues to captivate riders around the world.
